description: A landscape photograph depicting a dirt track or path running along the bank of a calm river or canal. On the left side of the track, a dense row of green deciduous trees forms a wooded edge. On the right, the track is bordered by green grass sloping down to the water. In the distance, a bridge spans the water body. The sky is partly cloudy. The image is copyrighted "©European Union 2012" and attributed to "LUCAS". This image serves as an example of a water course which might be classified as a "highly modified water course" or "artificial water course" in environmental monitoring contexts, such as those related to the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC).
